effort: medium (inherited CLAUDE_EFFORT, as in VAC-001 and ARCH-001)
condition: K1 isolated-cli: one headless `claude -p` process per agent turn; long-lived arms continue their own session with --resume
autoCompactNote: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200000 in every arm, so that long-lived sessions reach context management within the chain (VAC-001 saw 0 compactions at 167k tokens with a 1M window). Identical in every arm; fresh agents never reach it.

tools.rationale: REL-001 run-03 / ARCH-001 K1 tool profile: ordo, archcheck and praxis are reached through Bash

environment.note: as ARCH-001: auth and proxy come from the inherited environment; the orchestrator's additional directories, CLAUDE.md files, skills, plugins, messaging channel and session link do not reach the agent; GitHub tokens are unset so an agent cannot fetch the experiment repositories; the orchestrator's CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE is unset so the compaction window is the one set here

prompt: You are a software engineer doing one bounded task. Your complete instructions are in the brief at {BRIEF}. Read it first and follow it exactly, including its limits and workflow, and end your final message as the brief says.
continuePrompt: The next message for you is in the brief at {BRIEF}. Read it and follow it exactly, and end your final message as it says.
promptNote: prompt: the REL-001 run-02/03 and ARCH-001 wrapper, byte for byte; continuePrompt: the same wrapper for a continued session
